definitions.explanation: A sofa that opens out or folds flat into a bed. Also spelled ソファーベッド.

examples.japanese: ソファベッド⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: I sleep on a sofa bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ソファベッド⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: A sofa bed is handy in a small room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泊|と}まり→泊まり：22935_tomari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦リビング→リビング：11198_ribingu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ソファベッド⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げて→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: When friends stay over, I open out the sofa bed in the living room for them.

notes:
A common choice for one-room apartments, where one piece of furniture has to serve as both sofa and bed.
